title: IO EMG vs load distance (P2 close vs P3 far, shoulder height) and load (0/5/10% BW)
subcategory: upright static load holding EMG (%MVC), antagonist co-activation vs load distance

quantity.name: normalised EMG
quantity.definition: surface EMG RMS over middle 3 s of 5-s hold, normalised to muscle-specific MVA = peak RMS (250-ms windows) in any of 6 standing isometric MVCs (flexion, extension, L/R lateral bending, L/R axial rotation) in a triaxial dynamometer (Larivière 2001b); averaged over 2 trials and over left/right homologous muscles; paper's unit '%MVA'

source.authors: Larivière C, Shahvarpour A, Gravel C, Gauvin M, Jean A-M, Viau A, Mecheri H
source.sample: 40 subjects (20F, 20M); healthy adults, age-matched between sexes (IRSST accepted manuscript)

protocol.summary: Distance-study: upright 5-s holds at shoulder height, close (P2, 0.35 x upper-limb length) vs far (P3, arms extended), with 0, 5, 10% BW. L5/S1 relative extension moment up to ~30% of extension MVC at P3/10%BW (Fig 2). Pooled sexes (n=40), bilateral average.
how_to_simulate: Upright standing, trunk vertical (C7 kept vertical with feedback; L5/S1 not moving horizontally), knees/heels stabilised
Hold the bar with both hands at position P1 (L5/S1 height, close; ~20-23 cm anterior to L5/S1), P2 (shoulder height, close) or P3 (shoulder height, arms extended)
Apply hand load 0.44 kg (0% BW), 5% BW or 10% BW (Table 1 masses)

Compare predicted activation of the IO (antagonist) under the electrode (bilateral (averaged) internal oblique, placement per McGill 1991), averaged left/right, with mean %MVC; key target is the DISTANCE x LOAD interaction (P3-P2 difference at 10% BW: RA 1.0, EO 2.4, IO 6.1 %MVA per text)

subject_model.sex: mixed 20F/20M (pooled data); simulate F and M subjects and average
subject_model.source: Larivière 2019 Table 1 (also: back strength F 166±33, M 271±70 Nm; lumbar curvature F 31.6±8.4, M 27.4±8.7 deg; L5/S1-to-guide-bar distance F 20.1, M 22.7 cm; shoulder-to-bar F 21.5, M 22.4 cm; L5/S1-to-shoulder vertical F 34.4, M 38.3 cm; 5%BW load F 2.9, M 3.6 kg; 10%BW load F 6.0, M 7.2 kg)

protocol.notes: SDs not plotted; caption SD range 4.4-9.1 %MVA. Text: P3-P2 at 10% BW = 1.0 (RA, d=0.48), 2.4 (EO, d=0.82), 6.1 %MVA (IO, d=0.82).

extraction.uncertainty: ±0.2 %MVC (±0.3 where P2 and P3 markers overlap: RA/EO 0% and 5% BW, IO 0% BW)
extraction.check_notes: Calibrated on 9 y-ticks (51.69 px/%); overlapping circle/triangle markers separated using marker height (33-34 px) from the visible outer edge (top=rounded circle vs pointed triangle checked by row-width profiles). Re-read visually: IO P3 10%BW ≈13.6, EO P3 10%BW ≈6.0 - agree.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= SD (caption range 4.4-9.1 %MVC); P3>P2 increase growing with load
